sys_scope.name: FlowTest — Automated Regression Testing for Flow Designer
sys_scope.description: Record, replay, and compare Flow Designer executions. Detect regressions after upgrades, migrations, and changes. AI-powered triage classifies diffs as BREAKING, COSMETIC, or INTENTIONAL.

sys_script_include.name: FlowTestRecorder
sys_script_include.description: Captures flow execution traces for regression testing.

sys_script_include.name: FlowTestReplayEngine
sys_script_include.description: Replays recorded flow traces and detects regressions.

sys_user_role.name: x_sn_flow_test.user
sys_user_role.description: FlowTest User — can record, replay, and view traces and suites

sys_trigger.name: FlowTest Suite Runner
sys_trigger.description: Runs all scheduled FlowTest suites daily at 02:00.
